title: Chapter 17 Impermanence
content:
Chapter 17 Impermanence

For his own strength, Denell is still very confident, and he is not weak in the surrounding area, or in other words, not weak in the entire surrounding roads of hundreds of miles.

Usually, the tribe is called a warrior, who can hunt down beasts, lions, wolves, tigers and leopards alone, and face the siege of several people without defeat. This kind of existence is worthy of being cherished in every tribe, and it is usually appointed as a big or small leader in charge of more than ten people.

Going a step further, like Denell's current situation, he has roughly mastered the vindictiveness, and can hunt and kill relatively low-level monsters, or he can face the siege of more than a dozen people without defeat.

Going a step further, you can even face more than 20 people. This kind of existence can already become some small tribe leaders with only one or two hundred people!

Denell became the patriarch of the Mengla tribe because he mastered the vindictiveness by chance when he was on the verge of death.

The person on the other side, who obviously did not have any special abilities, was able to fight against him without defeat. It was unbelievable.

However, only by beheading the head of this kind of existence can one have a sense of accomplishment, not like ordinary people who are defeated with one blow and can be killed at will, who can win so easily, but it is boring.

Wang Daniu raised all his strength, his heart was full of fighting spirit, and his eyes lit up with anger. He clenched the machete in his hand again, and swung it over, as if to cut off the enemy in front of him and divide it into two sections.

That is the knife that condensed his whole body, as fast as lightning, a white rainbow flashed past, and it came to Denell in an instant.

"Shh!"

Before the knife arrived, the voice came over. Faced with such a sharp knife, Denier also slightly changed color, and quickly set up the long knife in his hand. With the sound of "Dang", except for the handover, his hands sank slightly, but he took it without paying too much price.

Looking at his relaxed appearance, it is obvious that he took this knife without much loss. Wang Daniu's complexion changed slightly, and he was shocked by the difference in strength between himself and him.

Afterwards, you came and went and exchanged hands dozens of times. Wang Daniu's strength was rapidly depleting. Gradually, his physical strength couldn't keep up. His face turned red and his movements slowed down. Obviously, such a high frequency of attacks , he couldn't bear it either.

Just as Wang Daniu was doing his best to consume Denell, Zhong Yu quickly removed some soldiers who were in less important positions on the battlefield. A total of more than 20 soldiers who escaped from the battlefield slowly blocked him. In front of him and Denell on the battlefield, he carefully separated himself from them and protected himself.

The troops used on the battlefield suddenly took away too much combat power, and the front line of their own was suddenly tightened. They could only barely maintain the stability of the front line, and could not actively attack, and the scene became anxious.

Now the eyes of the entire battlefield are focused on Denier and Wang Daniel. If Wang Daniel can block and repel Denier, then the scale of victory will slowly tilt to his side.

And if De Nair defeated Wang Daniu, Zhong Yu could only hope that the twenty-odd soldiers in front of him could kill De Nair, and the battle situation could barely remain undefeated.

If Wang Daniu was killed by Denell and Denell rushed up, then even if he had exhausted all his troops, he would have to kill Denell, which would severely dampen the morale of the barbarian coalition.

At that time, the allied barbarians who lost their spiritual leaders, and Denell, who they thought was unparalleled in bravery, were killed by themselves, and they would inevitably fall into chaos and their morale would be greatly reduced.

The leader of the Mengla tribe was killed by the enemy. The leader of the Aisen tribe, whom he regarded as an enemy for generations, is still alive. The people of the Mengla tribe will definitely not give up easily, and the people of the Aisen tribe will not give up this Great opportunity to destroy and annex mortal enemies.

They will fall into a period of chaos that will last for several months. Their most important foreign enemy, their most important foreign enemy, has severely damaged all their troops. They are almost incapable of attacking outside except for self-protection. stand up.

It is a habit of human beings that all things are no exception. It is regarded as a wise saying by countless people. Without external pressure, internal contradictions will erupt, forming a kind of flame and burning everything.

At that time, his own recruits will be trained, three hundred people, enough to destroy all the barbarian tribes in one fell swoop, and will not repeat this mistake.

However, let's take a look now, Wang Daniu's ability and Denier's strength, the victory or defeat between them will determine the trend of the entire battlefield and cannot be ignored.

Everyone, as long as there is no danger and enough free time, will intentionally or unintentionally look at the battlefield of Wang Daniu and Denier. This is related to their fate for a while, and all their minds are tightly bound. .

Outside the battlefield, Anderson looked at Denell's sudden outburst of power, and seemed to be surprised. He didn't understand how Denell, who was not so brave just now, could suddenly be so powerful and incomparably brave.

However, as a savage, if you think about it carefully, you can guess that it should be the ancestral god they believe in - the God of Menghu, seeing the power given by the tribe at a critical moment of survival!

However, to endow the human body with the power of the gods? Whether it is for God or man, it is a great loss. The gods will be in a state of weakness for a long time, and human beings will also greatly consume their spiritual and physical potential, and their lifespan will be greatly reduced.

That's fine, after winning the victory, as long as he waits for a few years until that Denier dies, then his tribe will not be left to him, and will be annexed by himself sooner or later. Fulfill your own tribe, a long-cherished wish for hundreds of years.

At that time, he may be respected as an ancestor god by the tribe! Since then, he has also enjoyed the sacrifices of the people of the tribe, and enjoys a long life as a soul.

After all, the words outside the line are of no use. In the battle between Wang Daniu and Denier, after all, he still fell behind. There were dozens of wounds on his body, the blood was slowly draining, and his strength was slowly dissipating.

Gradually, the action was delayed a bit, Wang Daniu was hit by Denier on the body, he couldn't react for a while, and fell to the ground, his life seems to be passing like this!

However, Wang Daniu did not make Denier any better. When he was stabbed to the point of death, Wang Daniu grabbed Denier's blade violently, and he also stabbed the Denier with his backhand.

His death-defying fight was beyond the power of the corpus. Even Denier's reaction speed couldn't keep up. Denier, who was stabbed in the stomach, seemed to have injured his internal organs, and the situation suddenly became subtle. up.

Denier, who was already winning, was injured by his prey's dying counterattack because of a momentary carelessness. He was seriously injured. How could he survive on the battlefield surrounded by powerful enemies!

It's not his own power, after all, it's not his own. Because Denell accepted the power of the ancestors, there was a slight block in his actions, so Wang Daniu seized the opportunity and gave him a fatal blow. The hope of surviving on the battlefield has been lost, and the right to live has been deprived!

Sure enough, there are times in life that there is a need for it, and there is no need to force it at all times. Does fate really like to tease people? It gives people hope, and immediately gives people despair. It's really impermanent!

Zhong Yu - The lion fights the rabbit, and it takes all the effort. Hunting wild geese all day long and being pecked by geese.
